organization_note: The Swiss AI Initiative is a national research effort launched in December 2023 and co-led by ETH Zurich and EPFL, the first initiative of the Swiss National AI Institute; it was seeded with compute on the CSCS Alps system and a grant from the ETH Domain. Apertus is developed with EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS, and the Apertus websites belong to EPFL. The pages reviewed name no legal entity for the initiative itself.
